facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published the findings report of the fifth Gambia Labour Force Survey, GLFS 2026 (Q1), a 157-page report disseminated in the second half of July 2026; the document gives no release date, so the published date 2026-07-30 is used.

The Standard reports that the Gambia Bureau of Statistics presented the findings of the 2026 Q1 Gambia Labour Force Survey, the fifth, at a national workshop (labour force 781,868; unemployment 6.2%); the story is dated 2026-07-30 and gives no separate release date.

facts.fact: The Gambia Bureau of Statistics published a report comparing its labour force survey across three rounds, 2023 Q1, 2025 Q1 and 2026 Q1; the document gives no release date, so the 2026-07-30 retrieval date stands in, and it was disseminated at a national workshop in the second half of July 2026.

UNFPA The Gambia reports that the Gambia Bureau of Statistics launched the preliminary report of the 2024 digital population and housing census on 17 September 2024, giving a population of 2.4 million, over 300,000 more than in 2013.
